input.summary: Add mutual successor-assignment right with notice and a not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard for other assignments
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only confirms the Agreement binds successors and assigns; it does not govern assignment, so HDI could transfer this Agreement (including to a competitor) without our consent. We have added our fallback position: either Party may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets on written notice, and any other assignment requires the other Party's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.

ops.text: Either Party may assign this Agreement to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets upon written notice to the other Party. Any other assignment of this Agreement requires the prior written consent of the other Party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.
